Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Nutrition plays a pivotal role in maintaining health and preventing chronic diseases. A balanced diet provides the essential nutrients that the body needs to function properly. These nutrients include carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins and minerals, each serving a specific purpose in the body's complex systems. Carbohydrates are the body's primary energy source, fueling daily activities and brain function. Proteins are essential for growth, repair and maintenance of tissues. Fats, despite their negative reputation, are crucial for energy storage, insulation and protecting vital organs. Vitamins and minerals, though required in smaller quantities, are vital for various biochemical processes. For instance, Vitamin C is essential for immune function and skin health, while calcium is necessary for strong bones and teeth. A deficiency in these nutrients can lead to various health issues. For example, lack of iron can cause anaemia, characterised by fatigue and weakness, while insufficient Vitamin D can result in bone disorders such as rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults. A healthy diet also involves proper hydration. Water is critical for digestion, nutrient transport and temperature regulation.Dehydration can lead to serious health problems, including kidney stones and urinary tract infections. Additionally, fibre, found in fruits, vegetables and whole grains, aids in digestion and helps prevent constipation and other digestive issues. Maintaining a balanced diet can help prevent chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes and obesity. Consuming a variety of nutrient-rich foods, while limiting the intake of processed foods, sugars and unhealthy fats, is key to long-term health. Regular physical activity complements good nutrition by helping to maintain a healthy weight, improve cardiovascular health and enhance overall well-being. In conclusion, nutrition is fundamental to health. A well-balanced diet, rich in essential nutrients and proper hydration, supports bodily functions and prevents diseases. Making informed dietary choices is crucial for a healthy and fulfilling life.Select the way by which to prevent chronic diseases with diet.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (By intake of nutrient-rich food) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage and answer the questions that follow.Climate change is one of the most pressing challenges facing the world today. It refers to long-term changes in temperature, precipitation, and weather patterns, largely caused by human activities such as burning fossil fuels and deforestation. These changes have led to more frequent and intense natural disasters like hurricanes, droughts, and floods, affecting millions of people globally. Coastal regions are particularly vulnerable, with rising sea levels threatening communities and ecosystems alike. Scientists agree that reducing greenhouse gas emissions is critical to slowing climate change. Many countries have pledged to shift towards renewable energy sources like solar and wind power to decrease their carbon footprint. This transition not only reduces harmful emissions but also promotes energy independence and green job creation. Additionally, protecting forests and promoting sustainable agriculture can help absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Reforestation efforts and the preservation of biodiversity play a vital role in maintaining ecological balance and reducing carbon levels. The impacts of climate change are not limited to the environment; they also affect economies and public health. Crop failures, water shortages, and increased disease risk are some of the consequences that threaten food security and human well-being. Vulnerable populations in developing nations are often hit hardest, despite contributing the least to global emissions. In conclusion, combating climate change requires urgent collective action from governments, industries, and individuals to ensure a sustainable future for the planet. Education, innovation, and international cooperation will be essential tools in meeting this global challenge.Identify the central theme of the passage:
options: The history of fossil fuels and climate change
The economic benefits of deforestation and climate change
The cause and effect of climate change and its migitation
Ways to increase industrial production and energy emmission
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The cause and effect of climate change and its migitation) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The study of ancient civilisations provides valuable insights into human history, offering a window into the lives of people who lived thousands of years ago. Archaeological discoveries have shed light on the daily lives and customs of ancient peoples, revealing how they lived, worked and interacted with their environment. These findings help us understand the development of cultures and societies, showing us the evolution of human civilisation over time. For instance, the excavation of ancient cities has uncovered artifacts such as tools, pottery and inscriptions that tell us about the technological advancements, trade practices and social structures of these societies.However, interpreting these artifacts can be challenging due to limited information. Often, archaeologists must piece together incomplete records and fragmented objects to form a coherent picture of the past. This process requires a great deal of expertise and often involves making educated guesses based on the available evidence. The context in which an artifact is found can significantly influence its interpretation, and without a complete understanding of this context, our conclusions may be tentative or subject to revision.Ongoing research and technological advances continue to reveal new aspects of ancient civilisations. Modern techniques such as radiocarbon dating, DNA analysis and remote sensing have revolutionised the field of archaeology, allowing researchers to obtain more precise and detailed information about ancient peoples and their environments.What is likely to happen when context is missing during artifact analysis?
options: Analysis will become faster and cheaper.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Interpretations may be less reliable.) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Technology has revolutionised education, transforming traditional classrooms and creating new opportunities for learning. The integration of digital tools and resources has enhanced the educational experience for both, students and teachers. Interactive whiteboards, tablets and educational software have replaced chalkboards and textbooks, making lessons more engaging and interactive. Students can access a wealth of information online, enabling them to conduct research and explore subjects in greater depth.One of the most significant impacts of technology on education is the ability to personalise learning. Adaptive learning software can assess a student's strengths and weaknesses and provide customised lessons that cater to their individual needs. This personalised approach helps students learn at their own pace, ensuring they grasp fundamental concepts before moving on to more advanced topics. Additionally, online courses and educational platforms have made learning more accessible to people worldwide. Students can take classes from prestigious institutions, participate in webinars and earn certifications without leaving their homes.Technology has also facilitated collaboration among students and teachers. Online discussion forums, video conferencing and collaborative tools like Google Docs allow students to work together on projects and assignments, regardless of their physical location. This fosters a sense of community and enhances communication skills. For teachers, technology offers tools for creating engaging lesson plans, tracking student progress and providing timely feedback. Data analytics can help identify areas where students struggle, allowing for targeted interventions.However, the integration of technology in education also presents challenges. There is a digital divide between students who have access to technology and those who do not. Ensuring equitable access to devices and the internet is crucial for bridging this gap. Additionally, teachers need adequate training to effectively incorporate technology into their teaching practices.In conclusion, technology has significantly impacted education, offering numerous benefits but also presenting challenges that need to be addressed. By leveraging technology effectively, we can create a more inclusive and dynamic learning environment.How does adaptive learning software benefit students?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (It gives personalised training.) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Jane Austen, one of the most renowned English novelists, was born on December 16, 1775, in Steventon, Hampshire. She was the seventh of eight children in her family. From a young age, Austen showed a keen interest in literature, encouraged by her father, who had a substantial library. Her works provide a vivid portrayal of the British landed gentry of the early 19th century.Austen's novels are known for their biting social commentary, keen observations on human behavior, and subtle irony. Her major works include 'Pride and Prejudice', 'Sense and Sensibility', 'Emma', and 'Mansfield Park'. These novels often focus on the lives of young women navigating issues of marriage, morality, and social status. Austen's sharp wit and keen understanding of social dynamics have made her works enduring classics.'Pride and Prejudice', perhaps her most famous novel, was published in 1813. It tells the story of Elizabeth Bennet, a strong-willed and intelligent young woman, and her evolving relationship with the wealthy and aloof Mr. Darcy. Through Elizabeth, Austen explores themes of love, pride, and prejudice, critiquing the societal expectations of her time.Austen's life was relatively quiet and uneventful. She never married, and her novels were published anonymously during her lifetime. It wasn't until after her death in 1817 that her authorship became widely known. Today, Austen's works are celebrated worldwide, adapted into numerous films, television series, and modern reinterpretations.What themes are commonly explored in Austen's novels?
options: Patriarchal norms prevalent in the lower middle classes

Comprehension:गद्यांश के आधार पर प्रश्न का उत्तर दें।साहित्य की ही नहीं तुलसी का यह रामचरितमानस तो हमारी संस्कृति की अमूल्य धरोहर है। हमारे सामाजिक, धार्मिक, राजनैतिक जीवन की मूल्यवान संपदा है। रामचरितमानस की रचना उस भक्ति युग में हुई थी,जबकि भारतीय समाज का जीवन नैतिक, धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक और आर्थिक सभी दृष्टियों से बड़ा दयनीय था। समाज के सामने कोई उच्चादर्श न था । लोग धर्म के नये स्वरूप को भूल रहे थे। ढोंगी और पाखंडी लोगों का प्रभुत्व था तलवार की नोंक से जड़ जमाने वाले मुस्लिम संप्रदाय से हिंदू जनता त्रस्त और भयभीत थी। ऐसे समय में तुलसी ने रामचंद्र जी के देदीप्यमान चरित्र को जन-जन के समक्ष रखकर लोकधर्म का महामंत्र दिया। संस्कृत के प्राकंड विद्वान होते हुए भी जनभाषा में उन्होंने काव्य की रचना की। पंडित लोग जिस ज्ञान को जनसुलभ नहीं बनाना चाहते थे। तुलसी ने रामचरितमानस द्वारा उसका द्वार सबके लिए खोल दिया। उन्होंने व्यक्ति, परिवार, समाज, राष्ट्र, पति-पत्नी, स्वामी सेवक सभी के अधिकार और कर्त्तव्य, मर्यादाओं एवं जीवन के आदर्शों का प्रतिपादन किया। राम, सीता, लक्ष्मण, भरत, हनुमान जैसे महान् चरित्रों की अवतारणा कर उन्होंने आदर्श जन समाज के संगठन का स्वरूप निर्धारित कियालोक धर्म  का महामंत्र किसने किसने दिया -

Comprehension:दिए गए गद्यांंश के आधार पर निम्नांकित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए--    जनता को राजनीतिक विषयों की शिक्षा तभी समुचित रूप से प्राप्त हो सकती है, जबकि उसे विभिन्न प्रकार की विचारधाराओं को भली-भाँति समझने और उनमें निर्णय करने का अवसर मिले। राज्य का कर्तव्य है कि वह जनता को ऐसी मौलिक शिक्षा प्रदान करे, जिससे उसके अन्दर विवेचनात्मक शक्ति का विकास हो और उसमें आत्मनिर्माण की क्षमता आ सके। इसमें नागरिक शिक्षा का सबसे महत्त्वपूर्ण स्थान है जिसमें न केवल राष्ट्रीय बल्कि अन्तरराष्ट्रीय कर्तव्यों का पालन करने की भी शिक्षा दी जानी चाहिए। स्मरण रहे कि हम लोग अब विश्व-संघ की ओर अग्रसर हो रहे हैं और हमारी सभी शिक्षा योजना में वह दृष्टिकोण निहित रहना चाहिए। हम लोग विश्व के अन्य भागों में होनेवाली घटनाओं के प्रति आँखें मूंदकर अकेले नहीं रह सकते । हमारी शिक्षा-पद्धति ऐसी होनी चाहिए कि हम आज के विश्व में सुरक्षा और सुख के साथ जीवन व्यतीत कर सकें। हमें अन्तरराष्ट्रीय शान्ति, सद्भाव और भ्रातृत्व की स्थापना करने तथा अपने दायित्व का निर्वाह करने के लिए सदैव प्रयत्न करना चाहिए। यद्यपि यह कार्य महान् है, किन्तु पूर्ण और सम्पन्न जीवन व्यतीत करने के लिए इसकी पूर्ति आवश्यक है। अगर हम साहस के साथ और सचेत होकर अपने कर्तव्य का पालन करेंगे तो निस्संदेह हमारा भविष्य उज्ज्वल है।प्रस्तुत गद्यांश में ‘उज्ज्वल’ का पर्याय क्या है?

options: आज की रात मेरे शहर में तेज आँधी आयी है।

Comprehension:दिए गये गाद्यंश को पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गये प्रश्नो का उत्तर देंमहात्मा ग़ाँधीजी का जन्म 2 अक्तूबर 1869 को  गुजरात के पोरबंदर में हुआ था। उनका पूरा नाम मोहनदास करमचंद ग़ाँधी था। उनके पिता का नाम करमचंद ग़ाँधी तथा  माता का नाम पुतलीबाई था। ग़ाँधीजी अपनी वकालत की पढ़ाई के लिए विदेश गये थे। वकालत की पढ़ाई पूरा करने के बाद ग़ाँधीजी ने  दक्षिण अफ्रीका में रह रहे भारतीय समुदाय के लोगों के मानवीय हक़ और अधिकार के लिए संघर्ष किया तथा उनका अधिकार दिलवाया। वहाँ से भारत लौटकर ग़ाँधीजी  अंग्रेजों से भारत को आजाद कराने की लड़ाई में उतर गये। ग़ाँधीजी सत्य  और अहिंसा के पुजारी थे। अंग्रेज उनके सत्य और अहिंसा के हथियार से डरते थे, इसलिए वे ग़ाँधीजी  को बार- बार जेल डाल देते थे। ग़ाँधीजी ने ‘सत्य के प्रयोग’ नाम से अपनी आत्मकथा लिखी है। रवीन्द्रनाथ टैगोर ने  ग़ाँधीजी को  ‘महात्मा’ की उपाधि प्रदान की। भारत को स्वतंत्र कराने में ग़ाँधीजी ने अपना सम्पूर्ण जीवन न्योछावर कर दिया। महात्मा ग़ाँधी को भारत का  राष्ट्रपिता कहा  जाता है। भारत में हर वर्ष  2 अक्तूबर को ग़ाँधी जयंती मनायी जाती है। तथा पूरे विश्व में 2 अक्तूबर को अंतरराष्ट्रीय अहिंसा दिवस मनाया जाता है। महात्मा ग़ाँधीजी की मृत्यु 30 जनवरी 1948 को गोली लगने से हुई थी।Q98. नीचे दिये गये प्रश्न का सही विकल्प चुनिए .
